sections.content: This unit covered demonstratives and questions (ez/az/mi/micsoda), naming objects with egy and their plurals, location with -ban/-ben and the article a/az, and existence with van/nincs/itt/ott.
sections.title: Unit review

items.english: What is this? This is a key.

items.spanish: Hol van a lakás? Itt van.
items.english: Where is the flat? It's here.

sections.content: Two different 'is' patterns this unit: Ez egy szoba (identity, no van) but A szoba itt van (location, needs van) — mixing them up is the most common beginner slip.
